name: ccn-business-management
description: CCN Business Management System - Chrome Extension, Web Dashboard, Android App

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter shared lint && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter extension lint && pnpm --filter mobile lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter shared typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter extension typecheck && pnpm --filter mobile typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter shared test && pnpm --filter web test
